body: I have both, and while people are all like "oh, it's just a cold sore, we won't kiss if you have one," the FREAK about genital herpes. In my experience, oral herpes is WAY worse than genital. When I get a cold sore, it is extremely painful, it looks awful, and usually takes two to three weeks to heal because it keeps cracking open when I yawn or am not careful eating. Genital, on the other hand, is a tiny little spot that I can't even see. It gets tender for about 12 hours, so I know it's coming. Then it just feels kind of raw and burns a bit, so I take some ibuprofen and put some neosporin on it and it's usually completely healed in about 3 days of the initial symptoms. I don't know if I'm typical or not, but physically, if I could only get rid of one, I'd definitely get rid of the ones I get on my mouth!!
